Sales Executive Job at Virgin-Landmarts




        
    

        
        Virgin-Landmarts is a Nigerian Real estate company headquartered in Lagos. Established to solve the dearth in global housing ownership as well as add value to individuals and organizations on a timely and consistent basis. Our core business includes Real Estate, Building Construction with modern architectural design, and property management. We are a team of highly skilled professionals, trained and equipped with the necessary tools to distinguish ourselves in the real estate industry.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales Executive
Job Location: Lagos 

Summary
     

            
    




	The right candidates will be responsible for generating leads and meeting sales goals.


Responsibilties


	Design and implement a strategic business plan that expands company’s customer base and ensure it’s strong
	Generate sale lead
	Negotiating all contracts with prospective clients
	Prepare weekly and monthly reports.
	Promote, sale the brand products and services.
	Attend to client inquiry on brand, products, prices, etc
	Meet the brand monthly set target.


Job Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, or Public Relations
	Experience in sales with 2 - 3 years of experience an added advantage.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Both Gender can apply.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position in CAPITAL letter as the subject of the email.

Note: Interested candidates must reside in Lagos preferably within this key region (Festac Town, Mile 2, Satellite Town, Ojo Town , Igando, Abule-Ado and environs).
